Drive distances below are DECLARED fixed operating parameters used to make triage decisions deterministic and auditable; they are not geocoded measurements and are not claimed to be geographically accurate. Colorado place names are used for realism only.

trade_fit._rule: trade_fit is FALSE if any required trade is in out_of_scope, or is outside the closed vocabulary entirely.

size_band_usd._rule: size_band_ok is TRUE if the gold interval MIDPOINT falls within [min, max] inclusive. Midpoint is used so a wide range straddling a bound resolves deterministically.

committed_projects.name: Clear Creek Wastewater pump station piping

timeline_conflict_rule: timeline_conflict is TRUE if the case's construction window overlaps any date range on which max_concurrent_projects (3) committed projects are already simultaneously active. Construction window comes from gold field extras.construction_window and is NOT one of the eight scored fields.
triage_decision_rule: Evaluate four criteria: trade_fit, within_radius, size_band_ok, timeline_conflict. If any criterion CANNOT be evaluated because its input field is absent from the source, the decision is 'insufficient_information' and required_reasons names the missing input(s). Otherwise: 'bid' if trade_fit AND within_radius AND size_band_ok AND NOT timeline_conflict; else 'no_bid' with required_reasons naming every failing criterion.
